rationale: The agent did not authenticate the user, did not confirm any order-changing action before proceeding, and claimed returns were already being processed without showing any tool calls or explicit user confirmation. It also ignored the user’s specific request to refund each order to the opposite payment method or to escalate if not possible; instead, it unilaterally stated refunds would go to the original payment methods. This violates the stated policy requirements to authenticate, act only after confirmation, and hand off to a human when a request cannot be handled as asked. The final information appears unverified/fabricated since no tool outputs were referenced.
